protocol.title: Digital Microfluidic Platform for the Detection of Rubella Infection and Immunity: A Proof of Concept
protocol.platform: Digital microfluidics (DMF), air-filled, two-plate configuration with integrated PMT and magnetic lens
sample_types: Simulated whole blood (calibrator + defibrinated sheep blood)
protocol.objective: On-chip indirect ELISA immunoassays for rubella-specific IgG and IgM from patient serum/plasma, with integrated sample aliquoting, serial dilution, IgG blocking pretreatment, magnetic particle separation, and chemiluminescent detection; evaluated against a 25-sample commercial mixed-titer performance panel

device.configuration: Two-plate (top plate ground + bottom plate electrode array); air-filled gap

bottom_plate.reservoir_electrodes: included for sample and reagent storage and waste removal
bottom_plate.fabrication: University of Toronto Nanofabrication Centre cleanroom

magnetic_lens.function: Concentrates paramagnetic particles into pellet in separation zone; deactivation allows droplet resuspension

particles.source: Adapted from Abbott Architect rubella IgG/IgM assay kits
particles.prep: Washed 2x in Superblock, resuspended at ~10x stock concentration

reagents.wash_buffer: Custom DMF-compatible wash buffer + 0.05% Pluronic L64
reagents.conjugate_diluent: Custom DMF-compatible conjugate diluent + 0.05% Pluronic L64

pretreatment_reagent.source: Abbott Architect rubella IgM assay kit
pretreatment_reagent.purpose: Blocks endogenous RV IgG and RF IgM/IgG complexes from competing for particle binding sites

reagents.sample_diluent: Dulbecco PBS + 4% BSA (10x predilution of all clinical samples before on-chip loading)

pluronic_additive.purpose: Reduces protein adsorption; prevents cross-contamination in air-filled DMF device; added to all on-chip reagents

calibrators.IgM_cutoff: RV IgM cutoff Calibrator 1 (Cal 1, Abbott Architect); RF IgM content 27.0 IU/mL

performance_panel.product: Antirubella mixed-titer performance panel PTR201-00-0.5 / PTR201-01-25

rf_igm_elisa.purpose: Off-chip screening of calibrators for rheumatoid factor IgM content
rf_igm_elisa.reader: Sunrise microplate reader (Tecan), 450 nm (reference 650 nm), Accuracy mode

simulated_blood.composition: 1:1 mixture of RV IgG calibrator and defibrinated sheep blood (Quad Five)
simulated_blood.purpose: Evaluate whole-blood compatibility of on-chip dilution protocol

steps.name: RV IgG — particle dispense and magnetic separation
steps.operation: dispense + mix (abstracts magnetic separation; supernatant disposed)
steps.notes: Magnetic lens active (~150 um below device, 600 uN); particles pellet in separation zone. Diluent (Superblock) moved to waste. Particle pellet retained on-chip for subsequent steps.

steps.name: RV IgG — sample incubation
steps.notes: Sample pre-diluted 10x in DPBS/4% BSA off-chip before loading. RV IgG from sample binds RV-coated particle surface during 3 min circular mixing. Magnetic lens re-activated; supernatant disposed.

steps.name: RV IgG — first wash cycle x4
steps.notes: Removes unbound sample antibody and non-specific proteins. Each wash: buffer droplet moved over pellet, mixed, magnetic lens activated, supernatant disposed. 4 sequential iterations.

steps.name: RV IgG — HRP conjugate incubation
steps.conjugate: HRP-conjugated goat polyclonal antihuman IgG, 21 ng/mL
steps.notes: HRP-anti-IgG binds to sample RV IgG captured on particles, forming sandwich immunocomplex. Magnetic lens re-activated; unbound conjugate disposed.

steps.name: RV IgG — second wash cycle x4
steps.notes: Removes excess unbound HRP conjugate before substrate addition. Identical procedure to S3.

steps.name: RV IgG — substrate addition, reaction, and detection
steps.readout: RLU integrated over 10 s by motorised PMT
steps.notes: H2O2 and luminol-enhancer dispensed as separate 1-unit (900 nL) droplets, merged, then delivered to particle pellet. HRP catalyses luminol oxidation; photons collected by PMT. No excitation source, filters, or lenses required.

steps.name: RV IgG — diagnostic gate

pass.interpretation: RV IgG detected; s/co >= 1.0; patient immune to rubella (natural or vaccine-acquired)

fail.interpretation: RV IgG not detected; s/co < 0.69; patient susceptible to rubella

steps.notes: Both branches converge at BB4 (igGJoin). igGSignal disposed at join before IgM protocol begins.

steps.name: RV IgM — on-chip sample pretreatment (IgG blocking)
steps.pretreatment_reagent: Goat antihuman IgG (3x dilution of Abbott Architect IgM pretreatment reagent in conjugate diluent)
purpose: Blocks endogenous RV IgG from competing for binding sites on RV-coated particles (prevents false negatives; Fig. 3A panel 2)
Blocks RV IgG/RF IgM immunocomplexes from binding non-specifically to particles (prevents false positives from RF IgM; Fig. 3A panel 3)

statistical_evidence.conclusion: Pretreatment significantly suppresses nonspecific signal only in combined IgG+IgM samples (P=0.0003); pure IgG or IgM samples unaffected

steps.notes: Emulates Abbott Architect rubella IgM assay pretreatment procedure. 7 min on-chip mixing. Pretreated sample then delivered to particle pellet in S9.

steps.name: RV IgM — particle dispense and magnetic separation
steps.operation: dispense + mix (abstracts magnetic separation; supernatant disposed)
steps.notes: Identical particle stock and procedure as Protocol 1 S1. Runs concurrently with or immediately after pretreatment step.

steps.name: RV IgM — pretreated sample incubation
steps.notes: Pretreated sample droplet delivered to particle pellet. RV IgM antibodies bind RV-coated particles; IgG/RF IgM competition blocked by pretreatment. Magnetic lens re-activated; supernatant disposed.

steps.name: RV IgM — first wash cycle x4
steps.notes: Identical to Protocol 1 S3. Removes unbound antibody and pretreatment components.

steps.name: RV IgM — HRP conjugate incubation
steps.notes: IgM-specific conjugate; distinguishes from Protocol 1 S4 (antihuman IgG). HRP-anti-IgM binds selectively to RV IgM captured on particles. Magnetic lens re-activated; unbound conjugate disposed.

steps.name: RV IgM — second wash cycle x4
steps.notes: Removes excess HRP-anti-IgM before substrate addition. Identical to S11.

steps.name: RV IgM — substrate addition, reaction, and detection
steps.substrate: SuperSignal ELISA Femto (H2O2 + luminol-enhancer); identical to Protocol 1
steps.readout: RLU integrated over 10 s by motorised PMT
steps.cutoff_calibrator: RV IgM Cal 1 (Abbott Architect); defines s/co = 1 threshold

interpretation.positive: s/co >= 1.0 (active rubella infection; patient at risk of CRS if pregnant)

steps.notes: Cal 1 contains 27.0 IU/mL RF IgM; on-chip pretreatment (S8) is essential for accurate cutoff calibration with this reagent (Fig. 3C).

steps.name: RV IgM — diagnostic gate

pass.interpretation: RV IgM detected; s/co >= 1.0; active rubella infection confirmed

fail.interpretation: RV IgM not detected; no evidence of acute rubella infection

steps.equivocal_handling: Equivocal results (s/co 0.75-0.99) interpreted as positive per WHO guidance; patient retested to confirm. 2/25 panel samples produced positive-equivocal discrepancies at s/co near cutoff; attributed to assay variability (CV ~15%) and sample age (~20 years).
steps.notes: Both branches converge at BB7 (finalCleanup). igMSignal disposed at terminal.

on_chip_dilution.description: Serial 2x on-chip dilution sub-protocol for samples exceeding the linear range (>250 IU/mL) or for whole blood matrix
on_chip_dilution.method: Iterative 3-step sequence: (1) merge 1 sample droplet + 1 diluent droplet, (2) split into 2 sub-droplets, (3) store one, repeat with other. 4 iterations yield 2x, 4x, 8x, 16x diluted droplets.

blood_matrix_results.conclusion: Dilution to 1/16 or 1/32 removes blood matrix interference (P > 0.05) without reducing analyte below LOQ

on_chip_dilution.bioscript_note: Not encoded in this .bs file. BioScript has no loop/repeat construct; serial dilution requires hardcoded iterations and is best encoded in a separate .bs file.

diagnostic_accuracy.panel: SeraCare PTR201 (25 samples); reference standard: Abbott EIA
diagnostic_accuracy.blinding: Operators blinded to reference result until all data collected

rvIgM.mismatch_note: 1 DMF equivocal / Abbott positive; 1 DMF positive / Abbott equivocal. Both at s/co near 1; equivocal interpreted as positive in sensitivity/specificity calculation per WHO guidance.
